Does anyone know if the character sheets will hold up to dry or wet erase markers so that they can be reused for different groups? It doesnt feel like pencil will do the job.

This would also let me track hero points on the sheet where it is intended, so it would be useful between issues as well as between groups.

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
I haven't tried it, but I would highly advise against it.

If you want to use the characters more than once, than I'd advise either xeroxing the second and third pge of the character booklets(the two you'd be doing any writing on) or just giving your players some scrap paper to write ther current HP, Boosts and other what-have-you on it.

posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
Better yet, buy a few binder sleeves from an office supply store (or a big-box store).  Slide those character sheets into the binder sleeve, and you now have a surface usable with dry/wet erase markers, with no damage to the sheets themselves.

It's what I do with all my demo characters and pretty much every convention game I run.
